name: config-flag-typo-refusal
title: Refuse a mistyped --config instead of silently ignoring the file
description: amc serve --conf f.json is unrecognized by the serve parser (allow_abbrev is off), so the token falls through to generate_argv, the config is never loaded, and an auth_token the operator configured is never applied. Found during 07-02-config-generate-key-validation and deliberately not fixed there: --por 9999 fails the same way, so this is serve-flag typo handling in general rather than --config validation, and a guard for one flag would be arbitrary. Decide the general rule.
creator: sdelmas
